instruction.text: Höre dir Mayas Meinung zu Identität im digitalen Zeitalter an und beantworte die Fragen.

atoms.sound: I think it is impossible to tell what a person is really like if you only know them online. They might make up half of their personality, leave out important aspects of their life and only show what they think is important.

atoms.a: What is the problem with online identities according to Maya?
b: You might lose touch with your identity in the real world.
Others might influence who you are online.
++People can seem different from how they really are.

instruction.text: Höre dir Mayas Meinung zu Identität im digitalen Zeitalter an und beantworte die Fragen.

atoms.sound: I think most of them don't mean any harm or want to seem different from how they really are. However, I think it is a natural process of us only wanting to show the best parts of our lives. We don't want others to think we struggle or have issues.

atoms.a: Why do people show different versions of themselves online?
b: ++They naturally only show the positive aspects of their lives.
Mostly, they want their lives to seem perfect.
People are trying to create a false image to impress followers.

instruction.text: Höre dir Mayas Meinung zu Identität im digitalen Zeitalter an und beantworte die Fragen.

atoms.sound: Our online identity might be part of our reality, but can never show our whole truth. So what do we see online? Perfect pictures and profiles of people without problems who live in great clean homes and go on holiday all the time. And we think that this is reality.

atoms.a: What impression do we mostly get online?
b: ++The people online live perfect lives without problems or issues.
Most of what we see is totally authentic and resembles real life.

instruction.text: Höre dir Mayas Meinung zu Identität im digitalen Zeitalter an und beantworte die Fragen.

atoms.sound: People forget that we don't see the whole truth but only the nicest parts of it. As a consequence, we feel bad because we don't live the same lives as the people online. We enjoy our own reality less because we always compare ourselves with others online.

atoms.a: What is the consequence of the false impression of other's online identities?
b: Seeing others online doesn't affect how we feel about ourselves.
We are often grateful for what we have in life compared to others.
++We value our own lives less because others seem to have better ones.

parentTopic.title: Learning about my own and others’ identity
